title: The projective line is a regular Noetherian one-dimensional scheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $\mathbf P^1_k=\operatorname{Proj}k[x_0,x_1]$ [def-sc-p1-standard]. Then $\mathbf P^1_k$ is a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]), it is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme], and its dimension [def-pc-dimension] is $1$.

source.place: Example Tag 01JE (schemes-example-projective-line), together with the standard dimension and regularity assertions for projective space

proof.text: The existing source instance [lem-sc-projective-line-smooth-relative-dimension-one] makes the structure morphism f:P1_k -> Spec k smooth of relative dimension one. Properness [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper] gives quasi-compactness of f, so quasi-compactness of Spec k gives CompactSpace P1_k. Smoothness implies local finite type; over the Noetherian base Spec k, LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian gives local Noetherianity [pqf-def-locnoeth].

Smoothness over the field gives regular local rings by [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-scheme-over-field-regular]. Choose an affine neighbourhood U of x. Its section ring is Noetherian by local Noetherianity. IsAffineOpen.isRegularLocalRing_localization identifies each prime localization with a regular stalk, using the affine stalk-localization identification [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization]. The criterion isRegularRing_iff therefore gives IsRegularRing Gamma(P1_k,U), exactly the affine-neighbourhood clause [def-weil-regular-scheme].

The projective line over k is nonempty: the rational point with coordinates [1:1] lies in both standard affine charts [def-sc-p1-standard]; the existing connectedSpace instance supplies this nonemptiness. Apply the fixed-relative-dimension theorem [lem-sbc-smooth-fixed-dimension-over-field] to f to get topological dimension one. Rewrite Scheme.dim using [lem-pc-scheme-dimension-local-rings] to obtain the required local-ring dimension one [def-pc-dimension].
